newsitem.title: USA: Kiwi International files Chapter 11 petition.
newsitem.headline: Kiwi International files Chapter 11 petition.

text.p: Kiwi International Air Lines said Monday it filed a Chapter 11 reorganization petition in U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Newark.
Kiwi said the filing was prompted by its debt load, a slowing of passenger traffic after the crash of a Valujet airliner in May and Kiwi's own partial shutdown.
Kiwi said it planned to continue most of its operations, and is in the process of securing at least $5 million in debtor-in-possession financing as its effort to reorganize.
